parameters.note: Selects NoiseBC and its noise scale; set per suite by scripts.
obs*(1-n)+n*obs_space.sample(); drone obs replaced by U[-1,1]; act*(1-n)+n*act_space.sample().
l=1.0, g=9.81, dt=0.02, RK4, action in [-3,3], 500-step episodes.
noise_cov*U[0,1) on a random half of each batch.
Only counts failures; does not filter.
Shift and scale from data mean and mean absolute deviation.
Seeds numpy, random, torch, and d3rlpy; no CUDA determinism flags, so GPU runs may not be bitwise repeatable.

Fraction of trajectories held out to score a separate evaluation model; the label model always trains on all trajectories, so labels are unaffected. 0 skips held-out evaluation. Replaces the never-read dynamics.val_percentage on main.
